当您的应用需要自定义鼠标光标样式、监听输入设备的热插拔事件时，可使用 Input Kit 的鼠标光标和输入设备管理能力
当您需要在录屏类应用中监听全局输入事件（按键、鼠标、触摸、轴事件），或在云桌面等应用中拦截特定输入事件进行自定义处理时，可使用 C/C++ 的事件监听和事件拦截能力
监听键盘按键和组合键输入并做自定义响应 / Listen for keyboard keys and shortcuts and handle them customly
处理鼠标点击、移动、滚轮和拖拽事件 / Handle mouse click, move, wheel, and drag events
接入触摸屏手指按下、滑动和抬起事件 / Integrate touchscreen down, move, and up events
在 C/C++ 层采集全局按键和指针输入事件 / Capture global key and pointer input events in C/C++
拦截指定按键或鼠标事件防止继续分发 / Intercept specific key or mouse events and stop further dispatch
获取外接键盘、鼠标等输入设备信息和连接状态 / Get connected input device info and connection status for keyboards and mice
监听输入设备插入拔出并动态更新设备列表 / Listen for input device plug and unplug events and refresh the device list
根据场景切换鼠标光标样式并控制显示隐藏 / Switch mouse cursor style by scenario and control its visibility
查询当前键盘类型并适配不同按键布局 / Query the current keyboard type and adapt to different key layouts
自定义系统功能键的优先级和响应行为 / Customize the priority and handling of system function keys
为远程桌面或云游戏转发本地键鼠触控输入 / Forward local keyboard, mouse, and touch input for remote desktop or cloud gaming
在录屏或辅助工具中订阅全局输入事件流 / Subscribe to the global input event stream for screen recording or assistive tools
do_not_use_when: 需求是使用设计系统组件完成导航、侧边栏、页签、图标处理、光影效果或应用内多窗界面，应改用 ui-design-kit / The need is to use design-system components for navigation, sidebars, tabs, icon handling, lighting effects, or in-app multi-window UI; use ui-design-kit instead

需求是实现TalkBack适配、无障碍焦点、语义标注、朗读反馈或面向障碍用户的可达性能力，应改用 accessibility-kit / The task is about TalkBack support, accessibility focus, semantic annotations, spoken feedback, or inclusive accessibility features; use accessibility-kit instead
preconditions: 工程已集成可用的 Input Kit 相关 SDK/头文件与链接配置 / The project has the required Input Kit SDK, headers, and linking configuration available
若使用全局事件监听、事件拦截等 C/C++ 能力，工程已启用对应 Native 开发环境 / If using global event listening or interception via C/C++, the project has the corresponding native development environment enabled
应用运行在支持鼠标、键盘、触摸或相关输入设备管理能力的 HarmonyOS 环境中 / The app runs in a HarmonyOS environment that supports mouse, keyboard, touch, or related input device management capabilities
inputs: 输入事件类型与回调处理逻辑 / Input event types and callback handling logic
鼠标光标显示状态或样式参数 / Mouse cursor visibility state or style parameters
目标输入设备标识、设备列表查询条件或热插拔监听配置 / Target input device identifiers, device list query criteria, or hot-plug listener configuration
需要拦截的按键、鼠标、触摸或轴事件规则 / Rules for keyboard, mouse, touch, or axis events to intercept
outputs: 输入设备ID列表 / Input device ID list
输入设备信息对象 / InputDeviceData object
输入设备热插拔变更事件 / Input device hot-plug change event
键盘类型结果 / KeyboardType result
鼠标光标可见状态 / Pointer visibility state
鼠标光标样式结果 / PointerStyle result
按键事件对象 / KeyEvent object
鼠标事件对象 / MouseEvent object
触摸事件对象 / TouchEvent object
被拦截的按键事件对象 / Intercepted KeyEvent object
被拦截的鼠标事件对象 / Intercepted MouseEvent object
被拦截的触摸事件对象 / Intercepted TouchEvent object
被拦截的轴事件对象 / Intercepted AxisEvent object

postconditions.statement: 已在代码中接入 Input Kit 相关 API，用于监听/拦截输入事件、管理光标或查询输入设备 / Input Kit APIs are integrated in code to listen for or intercept input events, manage the cursor, or query input devices
postconditions.judge_prompt: Does the edit set add or modify code that clearly calls Input Kit-related APIs for input event handling, cursor control, or input device management?

postconditions.statement: 已实现与需求对应的输入处理逻辑，例如注册监听器、设置光标样式、查询设备列表或处理热插拔事件 / The requested input handling logic is implemented, such as registering listeners, setting cursor styles, querying device lists, or handling hot-plug events
postconditions.judge_prompt: By inspecting the edits, is there concrete logic implementing the requested Input Kit behavior (listener registration, cursor style changes, device queries, or hot-plug handling)?

postconditions.statement: 未将需求误实现为输入法、传感器、手写笔专属或游戏手柄专属方案 / The solution is not incorrectly implemented as an IME, sensor, stylus-specific, or game-controller-specific solution
postconditions.judge_prompt: Do the edits stay within generic Input Kit scope rather than switching to IME, sensor, stylus-only, or game-controller-only APIs for the core task?
